experiment.hypothesis: Sizing equity risk from the remaining capital cushion can keep the simulated risk-controlled mandate below a 25% maximum drawdown without changing the ranking or portfolio-construction alpha model.
experiment.title: High-water-mark drawdown budget

selected_policy.design_rationale: A 22% soft capital cushion paired with a 3x multiplier budgets for an approximately one-third equity shock before the soft floor is consumed. The floor is a sizing target, not a guarantee.

activation.first_eligible_observation: First release-aligned, point-in-time portfolio snapshot generated after approval

verdict.reason: All frozen drawdown, return-retention, temporal-confirmation, cost, neighborhood, and bootstrap gates passed; canonical promotion is withheld because the confirmation segment was not pristine and explicit release approval has not been given.
